title: ModernFix issue #619: Integrated server watchdog not sending thread dump when server thread stalls in a certain save
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by Appulcake]
### Bug Description

This issue report is related to a user in FTB Discord having trouble loading their save.
Context is modpack FTB Stoneblock 4 (1.4.0), using MC 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.216, ModernFix version `modernfix-neoforge-5.25.1+mc1.21.1`, when loading a (certain) save in Single Player.
Pack comes with a `modernfix-mixins.properties` shipped by default overriding one entry (`mixin.perf.model_optimizations=false`), not touching `mixin.feature.integrated_server_watchdog` from default of true.

There's an issue caused by Irregular Implements mod in the pack that under certain conditions indefinitely stalls the server thread on save load (https://github.com/FTBTeam/FTB-Modpack-Issues/issues/10755). This is usually quickly recognised in crash assistant reports, as ModernFix does an integrated server thread dump normally on this stall, where it becomes quickly obvious that it's this issue based on where the Server Thread is stuck. In this case, updating irregular implements fixes this issue.

However, for this one user's save, this doesn't happen. I could reproduce this, using Java `21.0.4+7-LTS` (bundled by FTB App), user had it happen on `21.0.7+6-LTS`, and then me again on `21.0.9`. I had to get a thread dump by doing a `jstack` output on it.

When I added a `mixin.feature.spam_thread_dump=true` override to `modernfix-mixins.properties`, it successfully does a thread dump every minute, including after this stall, in which the Server Thread is all stuck on Timed Waiting, so it seems capable of doing a dump it's just not triggering to do it for some reason despite the indefinite stall.

### Reproduction Steps

Unfortunately, I don't know what's different about this user's save that doesn't trigger this behaviour, that all previous saves with this issue do normally trigger a thread dump for.

I've included the user's save here (deleted other dimensions + trimmed down their dimension to reduce save file size, while still able to reproduce the issue): [New World.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24194416/New.World.zip)
Loading this in a fresh unmodified FTB Stoneblock 4 (pack version 1.4.0) seems to reproduce this issue.

### Log File

Example logs where save loading stalls but no ModernFix integrated server thread dump happens: [Latest.log](https://mclo.gs/IWXq0WW) (mine) | [Latest.log (Head)](https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/ZXLow2Y) [Latest.log (Tail)](https://gnomebot.dev/paste/mclogs/0r5Laab) (part of user's original report)

[comment by embeddedt (owner)]
I believe this is by design. The integrated server watchdog is started after the server finishes initializing (i.e. the initial chunks have loaded, but the client may not have joined the world yet). A side effect of this is that it cannot capture deadlocks that happen during the initial chunkload. `mixin.perf.spam_thread_dump=true` is the recommended workaround in such situations, as it is not dependent on monitoring the server's "next tick time" data to capture thread information.

Enabling the watchdog earlier will almost certainly result in a lot of false positive messages because there is no real ticking happening yet, and the chunkloading can take quite some time especially on weak systems.

I would guess that in cases where it does happen to work, spawn chunk preloading is disabled, so the server has technically begun ticking at the point that it loads the problematic chunk.
